Notes: A custom designed PCB with an ESP32-S3 chip for processing.
8-16 ohm, electromagnetic (NOT piezo). Frame unit: GD-02 style compact drivers.
Mono audio out, drives bone-conduction transducers; gate via SD pin for power.
Total of about 400mAh, should last a full day of use before charge.
heart rate sensor for emotion mapping.
Always-on wake-on-sound, wakes ESP32 from deep sleep via GPIO. Only peripheral that stays powered in deep sleep.
Primary speech mic I2S into S3.
Transparent face shield to be cut to size for glasses lenses.
A 50Ω 100mm 4dBi Antenna, plugs into board's U.FL port.
